notice_types.purpose: Explain relevant personal data processing and applicable individual rights.
Explain relevant cookie and tracking practices.
Capture consent when the applicable process or law requires it.
Support required disclosures and consent for remote care.
Record applicable communication preferences and permissions.

review_questions: Why is each data category collected?
What lawful basis or authorization applies?
Is consent required for this particular processing?
How can users withdraw consent where applicable?
Are records of consent or preferences required?
Are additional notices required for minors or representatives?
interface_requirements: Avoid misleading or coercive consent choices.
Do not bundle unrelated permissions without appropriate justification.
Honor recorded preferences and withdrawals where applicable.
rules: Do not assume a checkbox makes processing lawful.
Do not assume one consent mechanism covers every purpose.
Do not activate non-essential tracking before the required permission where applicable.
Have the applicable notices and consent model reviewed before launch.
